about: Outside research (Brandon Oct 31 9:35 PM, updated Nov 1 12:14 AM): official park acres by agency (US + Canada). Agencies = list page / download per agency; Acres not downloadable = sizes copied by hand. Waiting room + chat 11 before use.

Agencies.Notes: NPS Land Resources Division quarterly acreage report (XLSX). Sheet 'Listing of Acreage' = 436 units; also 'NPS Fee Acres' / 'Subtotal Federal Acres' columns; sheets 'Acreage by State' and 'Summary of Acreage'. Earlier quarters on same page.

Agencies.Size column name: NFS Acreage (also Other Acreage, Total Acreage)
Agencies.Notes: Land Areas of the National Forest System FY2025, LAR_FY2025.xlsx in the USFS public Box folder linked from the LAR page (data as of 9/30/2025, refreshed 10/24/2025). Sheet T04 'Areas by State' = 363 unit-by-state rows; T03 by region; T07 wilderness by state (622 rows); T13 wild & scenic rivers; T15 NRAs; T18 national monuments. Book PDF and per-table PDFs in same Box folder (FY2025).

Annual Report of Lands (Statistical Data Tables) as of 9/30/2025, PDF only (text-based; reads cleanly with pdftotext -layout). Table 3 = National Wildlife Refuges by state/unit, Grand Total 573 refuges; Table 4 = Waterfowl Production Areas by county; Table 3A = marine monuments. No CSV/XLSX version found.

Agencies.Size column name: BLM-Administered Lands (Acres); wilderness table: BLM Acres
Agencies.Notes: BLM Public Land Statistics 2025 (PDF, 29 MB, text-based). Tables 5-2 (31 National Monuments), 5-3a (19 NCAs), 5-3b (6 other units), 5-4 (263 designated wilderness areas) on pp. 189-208; 5-5 WSAs (491, not itemised per unit with acres here). Count 319 = 31+19+6+263. Same NM/NCA units as a web table: https://www.blm.gov/programs/national-conservation-lands/about/maps-data-and-resources/NM-Detail-Table

No official all-lakes acreage list found. USACE NRMS data files (corpslakes.erdc.dren.mil/employees/nrms/data.cfm, which carry project/rec-area acres) returned HTTP 503 on 2026-10-31. USACE GeoSpatial 'USACE Recreation Areas' layer (https://services7.arcgis.com/n1YM8pTrFmm7L4hs/arcgis/rest/services/usace_recreation_areas/FeatureServer/0, 3,659 polygons) has no acreage field (only Shape__Area in degrees). Retry NRMS later.

Agencies.Agency: National Wild and Scenic Rivers System
Agencies.Notes: River Mileage Classifications table (PDF, Dec 2022, 228 numbered river units, total 13,466.8 mi). Size is river MILES, not acres - corridors are ~320 acres/mile on average by law but no corridor acreage list exists. The river-miles web page loads its table by script (CSV button) - couldn't verify the CSV by curl. Rivers designated after Dec 2022 missing from PDF.

Parks Canada's own open data ('Places administered by Parks Canada' CSV) has no official area - only Shape__Area in Web Mercator. Official areas are in ECCC's CPCAD (Government of Canada): REST query link here returns all Parks Canada records as JSON (87 records / 65 names: 47 national parks + 1 park reserve type, 3 NMCAs, Rouge NUP, Fathom Five, Saguenay marine park, NHS). Several parks have multiple records (zones) - group by NAME_E. Full GDB: https://data-donnees.az.ec.gc.ca/data/species/protectrestore/canadian-protected-conserved-areas-database/Databases
